name: Nigiri & Sashimi (Salmon, Tuna, Yellowtail, Tamago)
whyItWorks: Raw or seared sushi-grade fish and sweet Japanese omelet (Tamago) over seasoned white sushi rice is arguably the cleanest, highest-protein, zero-fiber meal on earth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for no sesame seeds on the rice. Dip in plain soy sauce and sweet eel sauce (skip spicy mayo, ponzu, and wasabi during flares).
